observations: Photo 0 shows the rear housing of an automotive alternator with cooling vents, mounting brackets, and a label that is not legible.
Photo 1 shows the side of the alternator with copper windings visible through the vents and an electrical connector.
Photo 2 shows the pulley end with the shaft and more windings visible.
All three photos show a used alternator on a tiled surface with a watermark reading 'FIDEL AUTO GLOBAL LIMITED'.
No brand, model, or part number is clearly readable in any photo.

claims.evidence: The label in photo 0 is too blurry to confirm brand, vehicle fitment, or part number.
Photos cannot show country of origin.
No test video or multimeter reading is shown.
Photos cannot capture sound or bearing noise.
Alternators have no visible mileage indicator; wear cannot be judged from exterior photos.
External photos cannot prove internal condition or seal integrity.

risks.risk: Alternator does not produce electrical output.
risks.proof: Video of a multimeter showing charging voltage at the battery while the engine runs.

risks.risk: Wrong part number or not compatible with Mercedes M278.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the label showing part number 439741 and vehicle application.

risks.risk: Bearing or internal mechanical damage causing noise or seizure.
risks.proof: Video of the pulley spinning freely by hand with no grinding noise.

risks.risk: Unit has been opened or internally repaired.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of housing screws and seals showing no tampering marks.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the label showing brand and part number
Video of alternator output test with multimeter
Video of pulley rotation to check for bearing noise
response.reason: The item is visibly a car alternator and can be priced at its worst case as a non-working core; proof of function and fitment would raise the value.
